verdict.rationale: Capsule documents a first-party v2 REST API over HTTPS with Bearer-token auth (OAuth or personal token) for integrating custom or third-party applications, so programmatic access exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI's features, and probes found no OpenAPI spec to check coverage. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for UI features (pipelines, tracks, email templates, reports, permissions, restoring deleted records), a published OpenAPI spec or endpoint reference, independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: API requests are made via HTTPS using the `api.capsulecrm.com` subdomain. Each request must be authenticated with a user's Bearer token.
Use Capsule's API to integrate with your custom or third party application.
you can generate a token directly from your Capsule account to avoid the oAuth 2 flow.
